snippet.title: Relic Abyss - Early access date and coming to consoles on 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now!
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017760/Relic_Abyss/
- PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016816
- Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/relic-abyss/9P5Q3PWWQDFW/

Relic Abyss is an action-filled anomaly that mixes lovecraftian fantasy with medieval sci-fi, bundled in a cute art-style and a banger soundtrack!

Explore a desolate yet beautiful world being consumed by the Abyss. Embark on a quest to preserve existence, meeting fellow adventurers along the way! Discover ancient relics, forge powerful gear, and evolve your skills to defeat primal evil and prevent catastrophe!

One day, a giant sinkhole appeared slowly devouring the world. Many refer to it as the Abyss. In it's wake, insurmountable amounts of unknown creatures were released and wrecked havoc upon the land. The world became engulfed with death and the creatures reigned supreme.

This is when Goddess of Creation called upon the remaining brave adventurers of the realm to take arms, and fight against the denizens of the Abyss. Tasked with destroying the World Eater, will they be able to save the world?

Play up to 20 uniquely designed adventurers
Over 134+ Unique Character Skills including Ultimate Skills.
Choose your own build path
Upgrade your equipment
Collect enemy cards and enchant your gear
Discover powerful relics
Procedurally generated levels
Randomized Perks System
Battle otherworldly bosses
City builder elements in an expansive HUB level
Meet interesting and memorable cast of Characters
Training to improve your abilities
6 Playable Levels with unique encounters
Incremental Difficulty Levels
